text: Ɓen waɗooɓe paŋkare jeenugol e rewɓe mon ɓen, woni laaɓuɓe maa ko woori ɗum, seedinee e maɓɓe worɓe nayo juulɓe nunɗuɓe. Si ɓen seedike yi'ugol rewɓe ɓen no faggitoo paŋkare ɗen, haray waɗiree leptugol ɓe ngol jogitagol ngol ka cuuɗi haa maayde nden arana ɓe, maa Alla Waɗana ɓe laawol yawtirngol ko wanaa jogiteede nden ka cuuɗi. Refti Alla Ɓanngini yaltirngal maɓɓe ngal ɓaawo ɗum, O Sar'ini piyugol jiwo jeenuɗo mo jombaaka on sawru teemedere e raɗeede hitaande, rajmeede ware debbo jinuɗo jommbaaɗo on.
